 dim_region {
 integer region_code PK
 text region_name
 }

 dim_date {
 date date PK
 integer date_key
 integer year
 integer quarter
 integer month
 integer day_of_month
 integer day_of_week
 text day_name
 text month_name

 }

 fact_consumption_daily {
 date date FK
 integer region_code FK

 numeric min_load_mw

 }

 date date FK
 integer region_code FK

 }

 integer year FK
 integer region_code FK
 numeric nuclear_gwh
 numeric thermal_gwh
 numeric hydro_gwh
 numeric wind_gwh
 numeric solar_gwh
 numeric bioenergy_gwh
 numeric total_production_gwh
 }",
 "config": null
